class.name: NetwSimulation
class.brief_description: Where and how one [NetwEntity]'s body runs on each peer.

members.member: The physics bodies this entity runs, as paths from the entity root. They are frozen on a [constant MODE_PROXY] copy. A root that is a [RigidBody2D] or [RigidBody3D] is always included, and a path to any other kind of node is skipped. Set it before the entity enters the tree, such as in [code]_init[/code]. The bodies are read once, soon after the entity enters the tree, and a write after that warns once and is ignored.

When a body of this entity runs here as [constant MODE_AUTHORITY] and touches a free entity that also sets it, this peer claims that entity with [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_SOFT]. A claimed entity claims what it touches in the same tick. It raises [member RigidBody3D.max_contacts_reported] on the bodies. [signal RigidBody3D.body_entered] and [signal RigidBody3D.body_exited] need the game's own [member RigidBody3D.contact_monitor]. It needs [constant NetwEntity.TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] on an entity with no [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property and no prediction, and does nothing otherwise.
The most ticks [constant RESTORE_EXTRAPOLATED] carries a sample forward.
The mode this entity runs in on this peer. [signal mode_changed] reports each change.

If [code]true[/code], the physics server moves this entity, so one with a [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property is predicted without a [member network_process]. Defaults to [code]true[/code] when the root or a body in [member bodies] is a [RigidBody2D] or [RigidBody3D]. While such an entity is predicted, [member RigidBody3D.max_contacts_reported] is raised to [code]8[/code] on its bodies so their contacts can be read.

The seconds the bodies must sleep before this peer releases the entity with [method NetwEntity.release_control], or [code]0[/code] to never release. It only releases an entity this peer holds with [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_SOFT]. It needs [constant NetwEntity.TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] on an entity with no [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property and no prediction, and does nothing otherwise.
Whether a copy whose state comes from another peer runs here or is interpolated. It can change at any time.

How a sample from the authority lands on a [constant MODE_ACTIVE] copy. Under [constant NetwDisplay.LIVE_MODE_CHASE] the body snaps to it and the drawn position glides, up to [member NetwPrediction.teleport_threshold]. Defaults to [constant RESTORE_EXTRAPOLATED] on a predicted entity with [member physics_driven].
When [member network_process] runs and when the physics server moves the bodies.

Called each tick as [code](delta: float, tick: int, is_fresh: bool)[/code] while [member mode] runs the body. Defaults to the root's [code]_network_process[/code]. [code]is_fresh[/code] is [code]true[/code] the first time a tick runs. It is [code]false[/code] when a rollback runs the tick again and on a [constant MODE_ACTIVE] copy, so play sounds and spawn nodes only when it is [code]true[/code]. Ask the physics space with a query. An [Area3D]'s overlaps and signals and [method CharacterBody3D.is_on_floor] come from the last physics step, and a rollback restores neither.

signal.name: mode_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member mode] changes on this peer, after the body has switched to [param mode]. A change made while [method MultiplayerAPI.poll] or a [NetwClock] tick runs is reported when that poll or tick ends.

constants.constant: Not simulated. The entity follows plain replication.
This peer has authority over the entity. [member network_process] runs and the samples go out from here.
This peer controls a predicted entity and runs it ahead of the server. See [NetwPrediction].
A copy that runs forward and installs each sample it receives.
A frozen copy drawn from history, where it collides.
[member network_process] moves the entity once per tick.
The physics server moves the bodies in each frame that brings a tick, and [member network_process] runs once in that frame.

The physics space is stepped once per tick, and again for each tick of a rollback. It needs the [url=https://github.com/diejor/godot/releases]Networked engine build[/url] or a [NetwPhysicsStepper] installed with [method NetwSession.install_physics_stepper]. Without either it runs as [constant SCHEDULE_FRAME], and so does an entity that is not predicted. Each case warns once.
[constant SCHEDULE_STEPPED] when the entity has a physics body this Godot build can step and restore, [constant SCHEDULE_FRAME] for any other physics body, and [constant SCHEDULE_TICK] otherwise.
The copy is [constant MODE_ACTIVE] while this peer predicts an entity with [member physics_driven] that shares a [NetwInterestLayer] with it, and [constant MODE_PROXY] otherwise.
A sample lands when it arrives, as it was sent.
A sample lands when it arrives, carried forward by its age along the property its interpolation projects by, for at most [member max_restore_ticks].
A sample is held until the clock's display tick reaches it, then lands as it was sent. A copy that turns [constant MODE_ACTIVE] starts from the sample at the display tick.
